description: AnSci's variant graph: surface forms and the canonical forms they resolve to. Data only — no word-specific knowledge lives in code. Unfiltered by vocabulary; ranking among a surface's candidate edges is the matcher's work. What is merely close (edit distance) is computed at resolution time and never stored here.

sources.name: Wikipedia, Lists of common misspellings — for machines
sources.note: Single-word to single-word pairs only; multiword corrections skipped.

sources.name: LoveToKnow, Text Message Abbreviations and Symbols Decoded; Wikipedia, SMS language
sources.note: Single-word canonicals only; phrase acronyms dropped. Surfaces with several canonicals carry one edge per candidate at reduced confidence.

sources.name: The Editor's Manual, List of Standard Contractions in English
sources.note: Surface = contraction minus apostrophe. Pairs whose bare form is a common unrelated word (its, were, ill...) were skipped at extraction. Wikipedia's contractions list could not be fetched; this published list was substituted and the substitution recorded.
